verdict.rationale: Cal.com ships an official hosted MCP server (mcp.cal.com) explicitly documented to let users 'manage bookings, event types, schedules, and more through natural language in any MCP-compatible client,' plus a dedicated agents.md guide enabling AI agents to check availability, create bookings, and manage event types via the API. A runtime probe confirms the hosted MCP endpoint is live and speaking the MCP OAuth flow, corroborating the docs. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on validation that natural-language commands work end-to-end in a real MCP client (only vendor docs and a protocol-level probe are available).
